00.short_title: The Best of Stories in Fifteen Lessons | Qur'an 12:3 #shorts
00.description:
The best of stories, in fifteen lessons.
In Surah Yusuf, Allah says that He relates to the Prophet the best of stories.
A dream, a well, a prison, a palace.
Start with the dream.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:3 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

01.short_title: Eleven Stars, the Sun and the Moon Bowed to a Boy | Qur'an 12:4-5 #shorts
01.description:
Eleven stars, the sun and the moon, all bowing to a boy.
Yusuf tells his father about his dream, and Yaqub answers with a warning.
Not every dream is for everyone. Choose who hears it.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:4-5 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

02.short_title: The Worst Plan Began as a Quiet Feeling | Qur'an 12:8-9 #shorts
02.description:
The worst plan in this story started as a quiet feeling.
In Surah Yusuf, the brothers say Yusuf and his brother are more beloved to their father, and they speak of killing Yusuf or casting him out to another land.
Envy keeps score.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:8-9 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

03.short_title: At the Bottom of a Well, He Got a Promise | Qur'an 12:15 #shorts
03.description:
At the bottom of a well, he got a promise.
His brothers agree to put him at the bottom of a well, and Allah speaks to him.
The promise came before the rescue.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:15 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

04.short_title: His Son Was Gone. Watch How the Father Answered | Qur'an 12:16, 12:18 #shorts
04.description:
His son was gone. Watch how the father answered.
The brothers come to their father at night, weeping, with false blood on the shirt.
Patience is not pretending.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:16, 12:18 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

05.short_title: Sold for a Few Coins. Not His Real Worth | Qur'an 12:19-20 #shorts
05.description:
He was sold for a few coins.
A caravan comes, someone says there is a boy, and they sell him for a reduced price, a few dirhams.
Their price was never the truth.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:19-20 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

06.short_title: Behind Closed Doors, He Said One Sentence | Qur'an 12:21, 12:23 #shorts
06.description:
Behind closed doors, he said one sentence.
In Egypt, the wife of the house tries to tempt him, with the doors closed, and he seeks the refuge of Allah.
Say the reason out loud.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:21, 12:23 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

07.short_title: A Torn Shirt Proved the Truth | Qur'an 12:25, 12:27 #shorts
07.description:
A torn shirt told the truth.
They race to the door, and the shirt is torn from the back.
Truth leaves evidence.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:25, 12:27 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

08.short_title: He Chose Prison. On Purpose | Qur'an 12:33-34 #shorts
08.description:
He chose prison. On purpose.
He says prison is more to his liking than what they invite him to, and asks Allah to avert their plan.
Be honest with Allah about your weak spots.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:33-34 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

09.short_title: He Asked for One Favor. The Man Forgot | Qur'an 12:42 #shorts
09.description:
He asked for one favor. The man forgot.
He asks the man who will go free to mention him before his master, but the mention is forgotten, and Yusuf remains in prison several years.
Waiting is not the same as being forgotten.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:42 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

10.short_title: Seven Fat Cows, Seven Thin Cows, and a Plan That Saved a Country | Qur'an 12:43, 12:47 #shorts
10.description:
Seven fat cows. Seven thin cows. A whole country at stake.
The king tells his dream, and Yusuf says to plant for seven years and leave the harvest in its spikes, except a little to eat.
Solve the problem, not just the puzzle.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:43, 12:47 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

11.short_title: A King Wanted Him. He Asked for the Grain Stores | Qur'an 12:55-56 #shorts
11.description:
A king wanted him. He asked for the grain stores.
Yusuf says: appoint me over the storehouses of the land; I will be a knowing guardian.
Ask what you can carry.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:55-56 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

12.short_title: A Hidden Bowl in a Bag Changed Everything | Qur'an 12:70, 12:76-77 #shorts
12.description:
A hidden bowl in a bag changed everything.
He puts the gold measuring bowl into the bag of his brother, and Yusuf kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them.
Not every insult needs an answer.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:70, 12:76-77 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

13.short_title: He Cried Until His Eyes Turned White, and He Never Gave Up | Qur'an 12:86-87 #shorts
13.description:
He cried until his eyes went white, but he never gave up.
Yaqub says he complains of his suffering and his grief only to Allah, and tells his sons not to despair of relief from Allah.
Grief and hope can live together.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:86-87 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

14.short_title: He Had Every Reason for Revenge. Listen to What He Said | Qur'an 12:90, 12:92 #shorts
14.description:
He had every reason for revenge. Listen to what he said.
Yusuf says: I am Joseph, and this is my brother. No blame will there be upon you today.
Let it go today.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:90, 12:92 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

15.short_title: Years Later, the Childhood Dream Came True | Qur'an 12:100-101 #shorts
15.description:
Years later, the dream from his childhood came true.
Yusuf says: this is the explanation of my vision of before; My Lord has made it reality. Then he prays to die a Muslim and be joined with the righteous.
Ask for a good ending.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:100-101 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

16.short_title: Fifteen Lessons from the Best of Stories (Surah Yusuf) | Qur'an 12:111 #shorts
16.description:
That was the best of stories.
Allah says there was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding.
Patience. Honesty. Forgiveness. Start again from the dream.

Qur'an, Surah Yusuf 12:111 (Saheeh International translation, as on Quran.com).

#quran #islam #surahyusuf #shorts #sunsetsurahs

long_form.title: Surah Yusuf: 15 Lessons from the Best of Stories (Quran 12)
long_form.description:
Surah Yusuf calls its story the best of stories (Qur'an 12:3). This video walks through it in 15 short lessons, in the order it happened: the dream, the well, the prison, the king's dream, the reunion. Every Qur'an line on screen is the Saheeh International translation. No faces are shown.
